row.content:
> **Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)**
> 8 For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
> 9 Not of works, lest any man should boast.

Paul teaches that salvation is God’s gift, not something we earn or produce in ourselves. Grace is God’s undeserved favor; faith is how we receive salvation, trusting in Jesus Christ and His saving work. Even this leaves no room for boasting, because salvation does not come from our works.

Works are not the price of salvation. They are its fruit: the next verse says believers are created in Christ Jesus unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). So we are saved by grace through faith, not by works, and a living faith leads to obedience and good works.
